label: copy phase: input digit 2 echoed back early (recall_idx 1-3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, when the fed-back input is the digit 2 and the step is among the first copy steps (recall_idx 1-3, meaning the 2 was original token 0, 1 or 2). Magnitude falls off steeply with position. It is strongest (about 0.85-1.0 of max) right after <DEL>, when the sequence started with 2 (recall_idx 1 carries about 69% of the mass), about half that at recall_idx 2, and weak (<0.05 of max) at recall_idx 3. It does not fire in the original or delimiter phases, on any other input token (only a few dozen stray letter activations), or on a copied 2 at recall_idx >= 4. Output token, next token and correctness do not modulate it.

issues: The core claims hold. On the dev split, 100% of activation mass is in the copy phase and 0 activations are in the original or delimiter phases. in_tok=='2' holds 1.000 of the mass, and the other tokens are stray (r 42, j 18, m 15, p 14 steps). By recall_idx the mass is 0.694 / 0.254 / 0.052 for indices 1 / 2 / 3, and 104 or fewer steps per index at 4 and above. Test scores for the predicate are reproduced: P 0.955, R 0.993, F1 0.974, mass recall 0.9997.

There is one systematic false-positive class: the feature switches off at the final step of the sequence (to_go==0). Predicate & to_go==0 has test precision 0.417 (2885 predicted steps) and holds only 0.24% of the mass. Examples: 'c 2 e <DEL> c *2*' and 'u u 2 v <DEL> u u *2*' are both inactive. These are short sequences (L=3,4) where a 2 at recall_idx 2 or 3 is the last output. The predicate with L<=4 has precision 0.79, against 0.987 for L>=5.

There is a smaller residual near the end of the sequence. At recall_idx==3 with L==5, which is the second-to-last output, precision is 0.85, compared with 0.98-0.99 for L=6,7,9. Firing seems to weaken when few outputs remain, not only at the very last step.

The explanation says 'output token, next token and correctness do not modulate it', but it leaves out the end-of-sequence suppression above. The label itself does not overclaim. All of the gaps hold under 0.3% of activation mass, so the verdict stays explained with this refinement.
